Metro Manila's traffic crisis: Philippines ranked most congested country in Asia

2026-09-23 Inquirer Opinion (Inquirer.net) TomTom Traffic Index, Metro Manila, Philippines, traffic congestion, Asia, navigation, urban mobility, traffic crisis
Read the source article

Quick summary

According to the 2025 TomTom Traffic Index, the Philippines ranked first as the most congested country in Asia, ahead of India and Singapore, highlighting Metro Manila's ongoing traffic crisis and the urgent need for comprehensive transport solutions.

Key takeaways

  • The 2025 TomTom Traffic Index ranked the Philippines as the most congested country in Asia, ahead of India and Singapore
  • Metro Manila's traffic crisis continues to worsen, with the TomTom data providing quantitative backing for long-standing commuter complaints
  • The TomTom Traffic Index measures congestion by comparing travel times during peak hours versus free-flow conditions across major cities worldwide
  • The ranking underscores the gap between infrastructure investment and population growth in Metro Manila
  • The data adds to growing calls for integrated public transport solutions rather than road expansion alone
